title: Don'tSneakProgress
description: Everybody cannot do anything until there're enough player online
body:
# Don't Sneak Progress
Have you ever played a modpack with friends, only to wake up and discover that the once familiar world has transformed into something unrecognizable? You went to bed as a caveman, but now you're faced with a world full of controlled nuclear fusion and automated slaughterhouse systems, leaving you completely overwhelmed. Clearly, your gaming experience has been ruined by your friends sneaking ahead!  

**Don'tSneakProgress** is a mod designed to enhance your gaming experience by ruining your friends' sneaky progress. By secretly installing this mod on the server and setting the minimum required number of online players, you can prevent the possibility of one dedicated player turning your peaceful farming civilization into a fully automated factory overnight.  

# Feature Overview
When the number of online players on the server is below the set limit, all players will be forced into Adventure mode. Only when the player count exceeds the set limit will they be allowed to switch to other modes.  

# Commands
The minimum online player limit can be changed in the configuration file or modified using the command  
`/dsp set <value>`.  
Use `/dsp get` to retrieve the current threshold.
